children.title: Iẓhār (Clear Pronunciation)
children.description: When Noon Sākinah (نْ) or Tanween (ً ٌ ٍ) is followed by one of the six throat letters (ء ه ع ح غ خ), the Noon is pronounced clearly without Ghunnah.

children.title: Throat Letters
children.description: ء ه ع ح غ خ (Hamza, Hā, ʿAyn, Ḥā, Ghayn, Khā)

children.title: Rule
children.description: Pronounce Noon clearly, no nasalization, no doubling.

children.title: Idghām (Merging)
children.description: When Noon Sākinah or Tanween is followed by one of the letters (ي ر م ل و ن), the Noon merges into the following letter.

children.title: Idghām with Ghunnah
children.description: Letters: ي ن م و — Merging with nasalization for 2 counts

children.title: Idghām without Ghunnah
children.description: Letters: ل ر — Complete merging without nasalization

children.title: Iqlāb (Conversion)
children.description: When Noon Sākinah or Tanween is followed by Bā (ب), the Noon converts to a Mīm (م) with Ghunnah for 2 counts.

children.title: Rule
children.description: Noon becomes Mīm, hold Ghunnah for 2 counts

children.title: Note
children.description: The lips should close for the Mīm sound.

children.title: Ikhfāʾ (Concealment)
children.description: When Noon Sākinah or Tanween is followed by any of the 15 Ikhfāʾ letters, the Noon is concealed with Ghunnah for 2 counts.

children.title: Ikhfāʾ Letters
children.description: 15 letters: ت ث ج د ذ ز س ش ص ض ط ظ ف ق ك

children.title: Rule
children.description: Noon is hidden, Ghunnah held for 2 counts

children.title: Ikhfāʾ Shafawī
children.description: When Mīm Sākinah (مْ) is followed by Bā (ب), the Mīm is concealed with Ghunnah for 2 counts.

children.title: Rule
children.description: Conceal Mīm before Bā, hold Ghunnah

children.title: Idghām Shafawī
children.description: When Mīm Sākinah is followed by another Mīm (م), they merge with Ghunnah for 2 counts.

children.title: Rule
children.description: Merge Mīm into Mīm with Ghunnah

children.title: Iẓhār Shafawī
children.description: When Mīm Sākinah is followed by any letter other than Bā or Mīm, it is pronounced clearly.

children.title: Rule
children.description: Pronounce Mīm clearly without Ghunnah

children.title: Madd Ṭabīʿī (Natural)
children.description: Natural elongation of 2 counts. Occurs with ا و ي when not followed by Hamza or Sukūn.

children.title: Madd with Alif
children.description: 2 counts - ا preceded by Fatḥah

children.title: Madd with Wāw
children.description: 2 counts - و preceded by Ḍammah

children.title: Madd with Yā
children.description: 2 counts - ي preceded by Kasrah

children.title: Madd Munfaṣil (Separated)
children.description: When a Madd letter at the end of a word is followed by Hamza at the beginning of the next word. Length: 4-5 counts.

children.title: Length
children.description: 4-5 counts (obligatory)

children.title: Madd Muttasil (Connected)
children.description: When Madd letter is followed by Hamza in the same word. Length: 4-5 counts (obligatory).

children.title: Length
children.description: 4-5 counts (obligatory)

children.title: Note
children.description: Both letters in same word

children.title: Madd Lāzim (Necessary)
children.description: When Madd letter is followed by Sukūn or Shaddah in the same word. Length: 6 counts (obligatory).

children.title: Kalimī Muthaqqal
children.description: Madd + Shaddah in word

children.title: Kalimī Mukhaffaf
children.description: Madd + Sukūn in word

children.title: Ḥarfī Muthaqqal
children.description: In letter combinations

children.title: Ḥarfī Mukhaffaf
children.description: In letter combinations

children.title: Madd ʿĀriḍ li-Sukūn
children.description: When Madd is followed by a temporary Sukūn at the end of a verse. Length: 2, 4, or 6 counts.

children.title: Length
children.description: 2, 4, or 6 counts (permissible)

children.title: Madd Līn (Soft)
children.description: Elongation of Wāw or Yā when preceded by Fatḥah and followed by Sukūn. Length: 2-6 counts.

children.title: Rule
children.description: Soft Madd at pause

children.title: Qalqalah (Echoing)
children.description: A bouncing/echoing sound when pronouncing the letters ق ط ب ج د when they have Sukūn.

children.title: Qalqalah Letters
children.description: ق ط ب ج د (Qāf, Ṭāʾ, Bāʾ, Jīm, Dāl)

children.title: Strongest
children.description: At end of verse with Shaddah

children.title: Strong
children.description: At end of word

children.title: Weakest
children.description: In middle of word

children.title: Lām of Allah (لَام الجلالة)
children.description: The Lām in the name of Allah is pronounced either heavy (Tafkhīm) or light (Tarqīq) depending on the preceding vowel.

children.title: Heavy (Tafkhīm)
children.description: After Fatḥah or Ḍammah

children.title: Light (Tarqīq)
children.description: After Kasrah

children.title: Lām Shamsiyyah (Solar Lām)
children.description: The Lām is not pronounced, and the following letter is doubled (with Shaddah).

children.title: Rule
children.description: Lām silent, following letter doubled

children.title: Lām Qamariyyah (Lunar Lām)
children.description: The Lām is pronounced clearly with Sukūn.

children.title: Rule
children.description: Lām pronounced clearly

children.title: Ghunnah (Nasalization)
children.description: A nasal sound from the nose when pronouncing Mīm (م) or Nūn (ن) with Shaddah. Held for 2 counts.

children.title: Letters
children.description: م and ن with Shaddah

children.title: Duration
children.description: 2 counts

children.title: Tafkhīm (Heavy Letters)
children.description: Seven letters that are always pronounced heavily (thick): خ ص ض ط ظ غ ق

children.title: Always Heavy
children.description: خ ص ض ط ظ غ ق

children.title: Sometimes Heavy
children.description: ر ل (depending on context)

children.title: Waqf (Stopping Rules)
children.description: Rules for stopping at the end of verses or words, including the various signs in the Qur'an.

children.title: Waqf Lāzim (م)
children.description: Must stop

children.title: Waqf Jāʾiz (ج)
children.description: Permissible to stop

children.title: Waqf Mamnūʿ (لا)
children.description: Do not stop

children.title: Waqf Aulā (قلى)
children.description: Better to stop
